slides.body: In Jyotish (Vedic astrology), the Moon signifies mind, mood and rest. Your Moon sign describes how your mind settles, or doesn't.
A fixed wake time, dim evening light and a cool dark room beat any chart tip. Astrology cannot replace these basics.

slides.h2: Where the chart adds a lens
points: Water-sign Moon: winding down often needs emotional release first
Fire-sign Moon: restless energy may need a physical outlet by evening
Earth-sign Moon: comfort and routine tend to anchor sleep
Air-sign Moon: a busy mind may need a screen-free buffer

slides.body: Astrology is not diagnosis or treatment. For persistent sleep trouble, please see a doctor.
